# CareerFoundry

> CareerFoundry offers career training programs funded through German government initiatives like Bildungsgutschein, specializing in product design and career transitions with mentorship support.

CareerFoundry is an online learning platform that partners with German employment agencies and DEKRA to provide accessible, funded education for career switchers and unemployed individuals seeking professional development in design and technology fields.

## Key Topics

- Bildungsgutschein
- Product Design
- Career Training
- Germany
- Free Education
- Unemployment Support
- Agentur für Arbeit
- Mentorship
- Career Switch
- DEKRA
- Online Courses
- Job Preparation

- German Employment Agency

## Funded Career Programs

- [Become A Product Designer With Your Bildungsgutschein](https://careerfoundry.com/en/courses/become-a-product-designer-with-your-bildungsgutschein): Product designer course funded by Bildungsgutschein with mentorship and AI training
